key_fixes_verified.problem: OpenCV.js WASM (10MB) was loaded in Web Worker via importScripts. WASM compilation would hang indefinitely in Worker context, blocking scanner initialization and freezing UI.
key_fixes_verified.solution: Replaced OpenCV.js with pure JavaScript implementation of all scanner algorithms in /app/frontend/public/scanner.worker.js
algorithms_implemented: sobel() - Sobel gradient magnitude and direction
cannyEdges() - Canny edge detection with hysteresis
perspectiveWarp() - 4-point DLT perspective transform with bilinear interpolation

scanner_workflow_verified.guide_phase: Shows tips, ready badge when worker initializes, camera button

scanner_workflow_verified.preview_phase: Shows processed image, filter buttons (Document/B&W/Original), manual crop button
scanner_workflow_verified.pdf_export: jsPDF integration for multi-page PDF export
